newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Sept wholesale prices up 3.0 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Thai Sept wholesale prices up 3.0 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The Thai wholesale price index (WPI) rose 3.0 percent year-on-year in September against a 3.5 percent increase the previous month, the Commerce Ministry said on Tuesday.
The ministry said wholesale prices rose 0.2 percent in September from August against a 0.5 percent month-on-month increase in the previous month.
The ministry said the 1985-based index rose to 156.0 in September from its 151.5 level in September 1995.
